A Rift-touched yeti whose natural cold-adaptation has been amplified into something supernatural by Veil exposure. Its fur is permanently frosted with Rift-ice, and its howl carries a psychic chill that saps the will to fight. Yetis in the Severed Lands are solitary — Rift exposure has made them too territorial to tolerate even their own kind.
## Traits
**Fear of Fire.** If the rift yeti takes fire damage, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.
**Keen Smell.** Advantage on Perception relying on smell.
**Snow Camouflage.** Advantage on Stealth checks in snowy terrain.

## Actions
**Multiattack.** Chilling Gaze + two claw attacks.
**Chilling Gaze.** One creature within 30 feet must succeed on DC 13 CON save or take 10 (3d6) cold damage and be paralyzed for 1 minute. Repeat save at end of each turn, ending on success.
**Claw.** +6 to hit, 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing + 3 (1d6) cold.
